name: Circus to Kimi to Kaibutsu
original_name: サーカスとキミとカイブツ
source:
A nameless, circus-loving boy, who was born with a horn growing out of his right eye, is forced to act as a "monster" in a circus as a spectacle. One day, while at the circus as usual, he meets a mysterious girl and......?

This is a story of a peculiar "bond" between a "worthless" boy and a girl.

[translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/54]Novelgame[/url]]
